description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for database connection, SQL query generation using OpenAI, and data retrieval for a school database, including prompt engineering and token cost calculations.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt string combining user question and additional instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message to OpenAI's chat API to generate SQL queries or answers based on provided prompts.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed between ```sql and ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database and fetches all results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL query, data, and table info.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates the cost based on token usage for query and answer generation.
